root_cause: Candidate metadata, risk routing, closure evidence and terminal writer intent were assembled by separate scripts and workflow steps. That duplication creates drift, repeated repository reads and avoidable integration commits.
prevention_rule: Compile candidate identity, adaptive test impact, closure requirements, canonical PR contract and exactly-one writer intent into one deterministic Integration Bundle before expensive delivery work. Existing Repository Writer and terminal writer lease remain the only mutation authorities.

evidence.expected: same immutable scope produces the same bundle hash and one writer intent
